i1.title: Swiss Arabian Vanilla 01 Extrait de Parfum 50ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Creamy white flowers and caramel coffee wrapped in Bourbon vanilla.

Swiss Arabian Vanilla 01 Extrait de Parfum 50ml is a rich floral gourmand from Swiss Arabian's 01 collection. Madagascar pink pepper, orange flower and coconut open, jasmine sambac and tuberose meet cappuccino and caramel in the heart, and it settles into Bourbon vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood and musk.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Pink Pepper, Orange Flower, Coconut
  • Heart: Jasmine Sambac, Tuberose, Cappuccino, Caramel
  • Base: Bourbon Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Musk

Key details

  • Brand: Swiss Arabian
  • Concentration: Extrait de Parfum
  • Size: 50ml
  • Scent profile: Floral · Gourmand · Vanilla
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A sparkling pink pepper and coconut opening
  • Creamy jasmine and tuberose with cappuccino and caramel
  • A warm Bourbon vanilla and tonka base
  • Rich Extrait de Parfum concentration

FAQ

What does Vanilla 01 smell like?

Pink pepper, orange flower and coconut first, then jasmine sambac, tuberose, cappuccino and caramel, finishing with bourbon vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood and musk.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
